Thank you, @AFPhq, for allowing me to speak about my bill, H.R. 3129, the Healthcare Fairness for All Act. This legislation promotes a personal option for patients and providers to ensure they are in control when it comes to health care coverage. https://t.co/EukXwOEfaj

It was an honor to participate in today's groundbreaking at Freedom's Path Waco. This project, located at the Doris Miller VA Medical Center in Waco, will redevelop and construct permanent supportive housing for the city's veteran community. I am committed to Freedom's Path Waco's mission of supporting veterans through their challenges. It is our turn to give back to those who have served our country.

Today, I had the opportunity to speak with physicians at the Doctor's Forum Fly-In hosted by the Market Institute. Providers and recipients of care alike recognize that there needs to be proper reform in our health care system. Doctors are on the front lines, facing critical challenges that lawmakers must urgently address. Their perspective is valuable and I appreciate them taking the time to visit Washington and have these conversations.

I had a great time as the keynote speaker at the Joy Club luncheon hosted by First Methodist Church Waco! I shared my insights on the future of AI and its potential in healthcare, education, navigation, and security. Embracing new technologies is essential, but we must ensure AI is implemented with care and proper oversight for safety and accountability. Together, we can harness these innovations for a brighter future.

This week, I spoke on the importance of federal nutrition programs for Central Texas at the 2024 Prosper Waco Summit. Prosper Waco is dedicated to improving education, health, and financial security for our community, and as a proud Waco native, I enjoyed sharing my insights. I highlighted the role of the Farm Bill, which many view as primarily focused on agriculture, but is actually the largest piece of federal legislation supporting food security. The Nutrition Title of the Farm Bill is crucial for enhancing access for families and modernizing food distribution. I am fully supportive of the Farm Bill and the potential impact it has in our communities.
Happy New Year! This year, we will work together to build a brighter future. I hope this year holds health and happiness for each of you! https://t.co/1FS26vIz0o
